feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing required UI updates and associated files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for key frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styling and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root container and Valentine-themed title.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App component that renders the ValentineProposalPage.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Component spawning animated floating heart emojis at random positions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useNoButtonDodge.ts: Hook that moves the No button to random positions on interaction.
frontend/src/hooks/useSoundEffects.ts: Hook loading and playing hover and success sound effects.
frontend/src/index.css: Extended global styles including fonts, gradients, glass effects, and Valentine theme.
frontend/src/lib/confettiLoader.ts: Utility that loads the confetti script and triggers confetti bursts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point initializing providers and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/ValentineProposalPage: React page showing a Valentine card with Yes/No buttons, dodging behavior, sound effects, confetti, and a success dialog.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, fonts, animations, and Valentine theme utilities with plugins and container settings.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project goals, features, and state for a Valentine-themed interactive single‑page app.
